annotations.title: Tax disputes: motions at a stage of the case

description: Statements and motions available at the current stage of an administrative tax case (renewal of the term, court fee relief, hearing with the parties, demand for evidence, video conference, reply to the defence, interim relief / suspension of the decision, change or increase of claims, legal costs, refund of the court fee, appeal against the first-instance decision, reply to the tax office's appeal; for a person sued by the tax office (P13) — objection to the reply, costs, appeal), with norms and why some are not available yet.

doc.description: response = the person is the defendant in a tax debt lawsuit by the ДПС (P13); default for P13.

has_case_number.description: The court has opened proceedings and the case number is known.

jurisdiction.description: State whose procedure applies. Only "ua" (Ukraine) for now.

stage.description: draft = not filed yet; filed = filed, waiting for the court ruling; opened = proceedings opened; hearing = hearings under way; decided = first-instance decision; appeal = appeal stage; final = decision in force.
